dedupe_keys.name: eastern japan airborne iodine 129 and caesium 137 after fukushima 2011

description: This deposit contains iodine-129 and caesium-137 activity concentrations and their ratios in airborne particulate matter after the 2011 Fukushima nuclear accident. The research collaborators measured 920 hourly samples from 41 monitoring stations in eastern Japan, then compiled the results at Waseda University. The public Excel workbook has one sheet per station and a final quality-information sheet, with sampling times, locations, uncertainties and filter materials. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The repository represents all 920 samples; the describing data article presents 557 that complement 363 reported elsewhere. Coverage is selected post-accident sampling, not the whole Japanese air-quality network or a continuous nationwide radiation map. A reviewer-assessed use is checking radionuclide transport or exposure simulation outputs against a documented event. model-flexpart-lagrangian-dispersion is a related transport model, while data-safecast-radiation-measurements measures a different radiation quantity. No workbook was fetched and no transport model was calibrated.
